method: Directly read every current Korean/English paragraph, outline and spatial intent; compared with the fully read original JA research and sealed actual source observations.

sceneReviews.reason: Three sentences ask how values create playstyle, promise Rivals/shared action and unique rules before Dungeons resources, and connect directly to shared movement/jump/attack. 134 characters; 20–30 seconds planned, not yet measured.
Shared actions and minimum usable performance precede differentiation; footage illustrates movement/platform actions rather than measured balance.
Visible fire, water and bubbles distinguish attention to opponent state from location. No numeric multiplier or unobserved teleport mechanic is asserted.
Similar figures and smoke change information. Appearance is explicitly separated from invulnerability, interaction rules and counterplay.
Ground/air/offstage opportunities connect useful strength with access. The close-pressure role is explicitly a hypothetical design example.

Preserves useful weakness, approach/return choices and opponent responses. Playable/enemy role and narrow-corridor/combination example are hypothetical and require playtests; selected footage does not prove placement effects.
Damage percentage and remaining stocks are current match state, not attack tables. Historical footage is not evidence of current rankings or universal formulas.
Hamir REACT defense/block, Slade STEAL coins and Artemis STUN opponent dice are separate shots. STEAL is not dodge, STUN is not regeneration, and per-turn dice are not permanent base stats.
Fleet SNIPE tooltip grants two stamina dice on the next turn, not immediate current +6. Separate boss STRIKE heart loss is not conflated with SNIPE. Trigger/target/time are explicit.
Differences do not establish fairness; test situations repeatedly rather than infer overall balance from one win. Repair unusable/dominant conditions while preserving role.
End/turn/ability interactions motivate concise explicit states and tests. The role question connects situations, tools and opponent responses.
Recaps the same shared baseline/strength/limitation/rule promises, state and timing distinctions, and a practical role sentence before the stat table.
